defect.locator_note: Treatment header and Treatment & subsequent history status line.
defect.problem: The good-law call matches the lake's final treatment field, but the visible page presents a clean good status while the full disclosed lake record flags the value as migration-seed treatment with an unresolved top-cited audit.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep good_law only with a visible qualifier that it is migration-seed treatment and that an R15 treatment audit is required, or complete the audit and update field_i_validity and point_overrides.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.
The listed progeny edges are marked proposed and field_iii mentioned, so they do not themselves establish a final overrule or abrogation.
But the derivation lane2_top_cited has audit_needed true and cap_hit true, and provenance warns that treatment was migrated rather than fully derived.
residual_risks: No disclosed final negative treatment of Smith appears; the defect is the unrendered audit/provisional status.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Render the scope note or audit marker next to the treatment badge.
